author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
GPT-5.6 is on par with Fable, but it is much cheaper.  No one will use Opus 4.8 anymore 

What will Anthropic do? 

If they bring back Fable to the Max plan, they are bleeding money. 

If they keep Fable behind API only, there will be a mass exodus of subscribers.

The business accounts absolutely hate the data retention policy of Fable.  They can't sell Fable to enterprise either.

Can they cook the book to make it look good before the IPO?
